en.text: Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau was coming, and with him four hundred men. He divided the children between Leah, Rachel, and the two servants.

zhSimplified.text: 举目观看，见来了，后头跟着四百人，他就把孩子们分开交给、，和两个使女，

zhTraditional.text: 舉目觀看，見來了，後頭跟着四百人，他就把孩子們分開交給、，和兩個使女，

en.text: He put the servants and their children in front, Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph at the rear.

zhSimplified.text: 并且叫两个使女和她们的孩子在前头，和她的孩子在后头，和在尽后头。

zhTraditional.text: 並且叫兩個使女和她們的孩子在前頭，和她的孩子在後頭，和在儘後頭。

en.text: He himself passed over in front of them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.

zhSimplified.text: 他自己在他们前头过去，一连七次俯伏在地才就近他哥哥。

zhTraditional.text: 他自己在他們前頭過去，一連七次俯伏在地才就近他哥哥。

en.text: Esau ran to meet him, embraced him, fell on his neck, kissed him, and they wept.

zhSimplified.text: 跑来迎接他，将他抱住，又搂着他的颈项，与他亲嘴，两个人就哭了。

zhTraditional.text: 跑來迎接他，將他抱住，又摟着他的頸項，與他親嘴，兩個人就哭了。

en.text: He lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, “Who are these with you?” He said, “The children whom God has graciously given your servant.”

zhSimplified.text: 举目看见妇人孩子，就说：「这些和你同行的是谁呢？」说：「这些孩子是 神施恩给你的仆人的。」

zhTraditional.text: 舉目看見婦人孩子，就說：「這些和你同行的是誰呢？」說：「這些孩子是上帝施恩給你的僕人的。」

en.text: Then the servants came near with their children, and they bowed themselves.

zhSimplified.text: 于是两个使女和她们的孩子前来下拜；

zhTraditional.text: 於是兩個使女和她們的孩子前來下拜；

en.text: Leah also and her children came near, and bowed themselves. After them, Joseph came near with Rachel, and they bowed themselves.

zhSimplified.text: 和她的孩子也前来下拜；随后和也前来下拜。

zhTraditional.text: 和她的孩子也前來下拜；隨後和也前來下拜。

en.text: Esau said, “What do you mean by all this company which I met?” To find favor in the sight of my lord.”

zhSimplified.text: 说：「我所遇见的这些群畜是什么意思呢？」说：「是要在我主面前蒙恩的。」

zhTraditional.text: 說：「我所遇見的這些群畜是甚麼意思呢？」說：「是要在我主面前蒙恩的。」

en.text: Esau said, “I have enough, my brother; let that which you have be yours.”

zhSimplified.text: 说：「兄弟啊，我的已经够了，你的仍归你吧！」

zhTraditional.text: 說：「兄弟啊，我的已經夠了，你的仍歸你吧！」

en.text: Jacob said, “Please, no, if I have now found favor in your sight, then receive my present at my hand, because I have seen your face, as one sees the face of God, and you were pleased with me.

zhSimplified.text: 说：「不然，我若在你眼前蒙恩，就求你从我手里收下这礼物；因为我见了你的面，如同见了 神的面，并且你容纳了我。

zhTraditional.text: 說：「不然，我若在你眼前蒙恩，就求你從我手裏收下這禮物；因為我見了你的面，如同見了上帝的面，並且你容納了我。

en.text: Please take the gift that I brought to you, because God has dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough.” He urged him, and he took it.

zhSimplified.text: 求你收下我带来给你的礼物；因为 神恩待我，使我充足。」再三地求他，他才收下了。

zhTraditional.text: 求你收下我帶來給你的禮物；因為上帝恩待我，使我充足。」再三地求他，他才收下了。

en.text: Esau said, “Let’s take our journey, and let’s go, and I will go before you.”

zhSimplified.text: 说：「我们可以起身前往，我在你前头走。」

zhTraditional.text: 說：「我們可以起身前往，我在你前頭走。」

en.text: Jacob said to him, “My lord knows that the children are tender, and that the flocks and herds with me have their young, and if they overdrive them one day, all the flocks will die.

zhSimplified.text: 对他说：「我主知道孩子们年幼娇嫩，牛羊也正在乳养的时候，若是催赶一天，群畜都必死了。

zhTraditional.text: 對他說：「我主知道孩子們年幼嬌嫩，牛羊也正在乳養的時候，若是催趕一天，群畜都必死了。

en.text: Please let my lord pass over before his servant, and I will lead on gently, according to the pace of the livestock that are before me and according to the pace of the children, until I come to my lord to Seir.”

zhSimplified.text: 求我主在仆人前头走，我要量着在我面前群畜和孩子的力量慢慢地前行，直走到我主那里。」

zhTraditional.text: 求我主在僕人前頭走，我要量着在我面前群畜和孩子的力量慢慢地前行，直走到我主那裏。」

en.text: Esau said, “Let me now leave with you some of the people who are with me.” He said, “Why? Let me find favor in the sight of my lord.”

zhSimplified.text: 说：「容我把跟随我的人留几个在你这里。」说：「何必呢？只要在我主眼前蒙恩就是了。」

zhTraditional.text: 說：「容我把跟隨我的人留幾個在你這裏。」說：「何必呢？只要在我主眼前蒙恩就是了。」

en.text: So Esau returned that day on his way to Seir.

zhSimplified.text: 于是，当日起行，回往去了。

zhTraditional.text: 於是，當日起行，回往去了。

en.text: Jacob traveled to Succoth, built himself a house, and made shelters for his livestock. Therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.

zhSimplified.text: 就往去，在那里为自己盖造房屋，又为牲畜搭棚；因此那地方名叫。

zhTraditional.text: 就往去，在那裏為自己蓋造房屋，又為牲畜搭棚；因此那地方名叫。

en.text: Jacob came in peace to the city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Paddan Aram; and encamped before the city.

zhSimplified.text: 从回来的时候，平平安安地到了地的城，在城东支搭帐棚，

zhTraditional.text: 從回來的時候，平平安安地到了地的城，在城東支搭帳棚，

en.text: He bought the parcel of ground where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for one hundred pieces of money.

zhSimplified.text: 就用一百块向的父亲、的子孙买了支帐棚的那块地，

zhTraditional.text: 就用一百塊向的父親、的子孫買了支帳棚的那塊地，

en.text: He erected an altar there, and called it El Elohe Israel.

footnotes.text: 33:20 El Elohe Israel means “God, the God of Israel” or “The God of Israel is mighty”.

zhSimplified.text: 在那里筑了一座坛，起名叫。

footnotes.text: - 33:20 就是 神、以色列 神的意思

zhTraditional.text: 在那裏築了一座壇，起名叫 。

footnotes.text: - 33:20 就是上帝、以色列上帝的意思
